messages:
rachel: Quick design check 1: attaching two small variants for streaming UI (floating pill vs right rail). Need quick call on stop/regen controls, token visibility on mobile, and prompt library placement. figma: https://figma.com/file/xxxx/playground-stream-variants

diego: Floating pill keeps the chat feel. Pill expands on hover to show Prompt/Output/Total. On mobile collapse to composer icon.

mira: A11y notes: use a single DOM node for updating stream text (aria-live="polite") to avoid screen reader noise. Stop must be focusable with clear outline. Token pill needs 4.5:1 contrast.

ollie: Implementation: two distinct buttons  Stop (during stream) and Regenerate (after). Regen disabled while streaming (aria-disabled). Esc mapped to Stop; Ctrl+Shift+R to regen.

rachel: Agreed on floating pill + separate buttons + tokens in footer on mobile. I'll draft spec and tooltips: Stop -> "Stop generation (Esc)"; Regenerate -> "Regenerate response". Mira will run SR pass. End thread.
